title: Brutus–Pell Atlas: Square-Rank Fibers, Collisions, Mirror Structures, and Reproducible Pell-Rank Anchors
description: An integrated reproducible atlas organizing verified Pell ranks into square-rank fibers, rank collisions, mirror-host structures, and rank-preserving constructions. The repository includes an exact modular rank engine, a curated anchor dataset, automated tests, validation labels, and explicit separation between computation, known theory, and research candidates.
